userStories.title: Fits in <80 columns
acceptanceCriteria: Every rendered line is at most 79 visible characters (excluding ANSI escapes)
Verified by a test that strips ANSI and asserts line widths

userStories.title: Mandatory sections render
acceptanceCriteria: Trajectory headline, headline moment, and follow-up panel are always rendered
If any input is missing, a clear placeholder is rendered for that section rather than crashing

userStories.title: Compact cost ledger and tasks
acceptanceCriteria: Cost ledger and Where The Week Went render in a compact form suitable for terminal width
Top-3 tasks are listed with label, session count, total cost, and worst dim

userStories.title: Six-dim panel as footer
acceptanceCriteria: The full six-dim panel is rendered as the last section
Each dim shows score, baseline, and significance-gated delta
